title: UI风格#180 - Dot Matrix (点阵风格)
description: 创建第180种UI风格：点阵风格 - LED点阵显示、像素化、复古数码管。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFX.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dot Matrix style When color palette Then features LED green, amber, red on dark
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#00FF00 (LED绿), #FFBF00 (琥珀), #FF0000 (红色), #001100 (暗绿底), #0D0D0D (深黑)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dot Matrix style When typography Then uses dot matrix: Press Start 2P, Silkscreen, or Dotty
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Press Start 2P (像素), Silkscreen (丝印), Dotty (点阵)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dot Matrix style When layout Then dot grid display, LED panel layout, segmented sections
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：点阵网格显示、LED面板布局、分段区域

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dot Matrix style When UI elements Then dot glow animation, LED pulse, grid scan
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：点发光动画、LED脉冲、网格扫描

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dot Matrix UI When functional Then includes pixel chat, LED agents, dot stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：像素聊天、LED代理、点阵统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dot Matrix UI When copy Then uses LED terms: 'Pixel', 'LED', 'Dot', 'Segment'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'PIXEL. LED. SEGMENT.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'DISPLAY'、'DEPLOY'→'ILLUMINATE'
